widgets_values:
这个节点把「图像1」那张定妆图钉在视频的第 0 帧。

作用：每段视频的第一帧就是你上传的参考图本身，色调从参考图出发，多段拼接时色调不会忽冷忽暖。

frame_idx = 0 表示第 0 帧；参考图会被居中裁剪到当前画布比例，所以换 9:16 / 16:9 时请用对应比例的图。

想取消锚定：删掉本节点，把 BasicGuider 的 conditioning 接回 ReferenceToVideo 的 positive 输出。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the speaking person in <Picture 1>: the same facial identity, geometry, apparent age, skin tone, hairstyle and body proportions. Her hair is a shoulder-length ash-blonde layered bob, softly parted just off centre, with the ends turned gently inward at the jawline.
<Subject 2> is the wardrobe in <Picture 1>: a relaxed white button-down shirt with an open collar, gold buttons down the front and the sleeves pushed up above the elbows, worn with a silver flower-shaped pendant necklace, reproduced exactly in cut, color and styling.
<Subject 3> is the environment in <Picture 1>: a bright indoor space with a floor-to-ceiling window on the left revealing soft-focus green foliage, white window mullions, and the deep red back of a leather sofa at the right edge of the frame, reproduced exactly.
<Subject 4> is the performance in <Video 1>: subtle expression, gaze, blinking and head rhythm only.
<Picture 1> is the visual anchor and the frame held at 0.00 seconds: identity, hairstyle, wardrobe, environment, lighting, framing, shot size, headroom, color temperature, white balance and exposure.
<Video 1> is a weak performance reference for subtle expression style, gaze, blinking and minor head motion.
<Audio 1> is the speech reference for <Subject 1> (S1): phoneme timing, lip-sync and pauses.

summary:
[reference generation] One continuous locked-off talking shot. <Subject 1> speaks in sync with <Audio 1> while the framing, wardrobe, background, character distance and color of <Picture 1> stay unchanged from the first frame to the last.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the facial identity, skin tone, ash-blonde bob and body proportions of <Picture 1> are retained 1:1.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the white open-collar shirt, the pushed-up sleeves and the silver flower pendant from <Picture 1> are retained 1:1.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the window with soft-focus green foliage and the red leather sofa edge from <Picture 1> are retained 1:1.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - natural facial expression follows the delivery of <Audio 1>.
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1], held at 0.00 seconds): fully_preserved - identical framing, subject scale, headroom, background alignment, color temperature, white balance, exposure and saturation of <Picture 1> throughout.
<Video 1> (performance reference): weak_reference - its camera motion, framing, subject scale, wardrobe and background are not inherited.
<Audio 1>: reference - lip movement follows the phonemes and pauses of <Audio 1> without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
The target video is a clean, natural, professional presentation in a vertical 9:16 frame with no on-screen text or graphic overlays.
[Shot 1] The shot opens on <Picture 1> and holds the identical framing of <Picture 1> as a fully static shot on a fixed tripod with a prime lens, with the woman seated slightly right of centre and her hands loosely clasped in the lower foreground. Camera position, character-to-camera distance, focal length, field of view, headroom, subject scale and shoulder proportions match <Picture 1> exactly and stay constant for the whole clip; the framing and subject scale set by <Picture 1> at the first frame are never overridden by <Video 1>. <Subject 1> wears the white open-collar shirt with pushed-up sleeves and the silver flower pendant, and sits in front of the bright window with its soft-focus green foliage; nothing else appears in the frame besides <Subject 1>, <Subject 2> and <Subject 3>. Color and light match <Picture 1> frame for frame: the same neutral-to-slightly-cool white balance, the same soft diffused daylight coming from the window on the left with gentle highlights on the face and the white shirt, the same low contrast, saturation and skin-tone curve, and the same green foliage tone in the out-of-focus background.
Movement stays small, local and speech-driven: lip motion, blinking, subtle breathing and minor head rotation. Her hands stay loosely clasped in the same position as in <Picture 1>, her torso stays upright with the shoulders square to the lens, and the upper body stays within the coronal plane.
<Subject 1> (S1) speaks using the timbre and delivery of <Audio 1> and says exactly, <d>[Chinese] 强者把话语权、安全感和结果都掌握在自己手里，所以，外界的评价、挫折和诱惑都很难动摇他。</d> Lip, mouth, jaw, cheek and chin movement follow the phonemes and pauses of <Audio 1>, and the face stays neutral with the mouth closed during silent pauses. The spoken words are acoustic material only: the framing, lens and character depth stay fixed while she speaks, including through louder or emphasised passages. If <Audio 1> ends on a pause, the motion settles subtly and the speaking state continues to the final frame without a pose reset.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet indoor room tone underneath the speech, with soft breathing and barely audible fabric movement as <Subject 1> shifts slightly. No second speaker.
